UCSB Department of Recreation

Instagram Analytics — Winter Quarter 2026

Mathilde Gourlin

May 18, 2026

1 Executive Summary

Winter Quarter 2026 ran from January 5 – March 21, 2026. UCSB Recreation published 67 posts and 22 reels, achieving an average engagement rate of 3.7% on posts above the 1–3% industry benchmark for institutional accounts. The dominant format was carousel (40 posts), followed by video (22) and image (5).

5 Key Takeaways

  • 67 posts and 22 reels published across 11 weeks.
  • Average engagement rate: 3.65% — above the 1–3% institutional benchmark.
  • Carousels outperform all other formats in both engagement rate and reach.
  • Top post: “This past weekend, the UCSB Triathlon Team held their ann…” at 7.9% engagement rate.
  • Top reel by views: “Congrats, future Gauchos, on your admission to UCSB! 💙 Se…” with 29,623 views.
  • Best posting day by average reach: Sunday.
  • Peak engagement week: Week 7 with 1,775 total engagements.
  • Core audience: Female (42.6%), aged 18–24 — aligned with UCSB’s undergraduate population.
